page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.small is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, configured with 1 physical core, 1 vCPU, and 1 thread per core. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache. It is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a 4.0 GB memory-per-core ratio. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.n2.small operates in the lower performance tiers. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU benchmarks both scored 1071.49, placing the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show 79.6 GB/sec for small cached blocks, dropping to 8.66 GB/sec read and 6.89 GB/sec write for large uncached blocks. Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 944.0 and a multi-core score of 944.0, reflecting its single-threaded hardware limitation. Database operations via Passmark scored 526.2, and Redis SET operations reached 1.3 million operations per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.n2.small offers a dedicated CPU allocation on Intel Xeon architecture, which avoids the CPU credit limitations of burstable instances but delivers low absolute performance per resource. The primary tradeoff is the low processing throughput and memory bandwidth, which limits its utility for resource-intensive applications.

This instance is suitable for low-demand workloads that require a dedicated CPU but do not demand high computational throughput. Appropriate workloads include basic static web serving, lightweight text processing, simple background tasks, and small-scale development or testing environments that do not require local NVMe storage or high multi-threaded performance.
